_doc: Tolerances for lookproof.mjs --compare against the approved reference shots. mean: mean absolute channel difference (0 to 255); share: part of the pixels whose largest channel moved more than delta. Signed with the style (P0-015, 2026-11-11) from run to run noise of the same build on this M2 Pro (stylised_b, 9 views at 1920x1080, sim held): golden worst view mean 0.03 and share 0.0%, night mean 0.03 and share 0.0%, afternoon (heat shimmer) mean 0.65 and share 0.2% in the busiest view. The limits sit about 2x above the worst noise, so any real look change (a new prop group, a light, a grade change) shows up and must be re-approved. Main reference: approved/ (stylised_b golden). The other three lights are named comparison sets: --against style_stylised_b_dawn, _afternoon or _night, with the same numbers.
